title: Add two vectors
ask: Two arrows start at the same point. Their **sum** is the diagonal of the parallelogram that they make. You add the x parts, and you add the y parts.

blocks.prompt: **a** is (3, 1) and **b** is (1, 2). What is the x part of a + b?

blocks.label: Two arrows a and b from one point, and their sum

blocks.text: Your prediction was for b = (1, 2), where 3 + 1 = 4. Now the x parts are 3 and {bx}, so the sum has {sx}. The dashed arrows show b moved to the end of a, and a moved to the end of b. Drag the end of b to the left. Where does the sum stand straight up?
